steps: 1. In **Loadouts**, leave **Use non-modded loadouts** off. With six or fewer rows, confirm Roman-numeral buttons and no page controls.
2. Add loadouts until **+** greys out. From the seventh row onward, check **<**, **>** and the **Page** counter; at the cap, the last page must read **Page 5/5** with XXV–XXX.
3. Use the buttons and Left/Right keys to page. Select XIII on page 3, change a weapon, visit I, then return to XIII; confirm its equipment and selection frame return.

4. On a newly created disposable row beyond VI, check the context-menu numeral and bot designation, then restore the previous designation. Delete only a disposable row created in this test through its held-delete menu; confirm counts/page remain valid. Close/reopen with XIII selected and confirm page 3 is restored.
5. If available, use a controller bumper from VI to VII and confirm automatic paging.

6. Turn **Use non-modded loadouts** on: expect at most six vanilla icon buttons and no paging. Turn it off to recover the modded pages. Enter the Official Realm and inspect its unchanged six-slot bar without editing it.

7. If the Versus hero/loadout menu is available, inspect it without queuing a match: it must retain at most six vanilla slots and no GUT pages. Return to Modded Adventure and confirm its pages remain intact. Record an unavailable Versus menu as unexercised, not passed.
assertions: Modded Adventure supports 30 independent loadouts in five pages of six, correct selection/equipment persistence, context menus, bot designation, deletion and tested keyboard/controller paging. Official, read-only and Versus selectors remain capped at six vanilla buttons without page controls.
issue231_loadout_paging PASS; script: add rows to 30, select XIII, equip, page away/back, assert store row and selected_index; readonly/official mode stays at six.
